t: An NXP wireless chip with Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth, and Thread for smart home gear.
steps: Buy an FRDM-RW612 board from NXP or a parts distributor for about $26 to $30.
Install the Zephyr tools on your computer by following the Zephyr getting started guide.
Run the command that fetches NXP's radio firmware files.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB-C cable.
Build and flash the Zephyr blinky example to light the RGB LED.
Try a Wi-Fi example to join your home network.
Watch the DigiKey video series on building a Thread border router with this board.
meta: Open Board. From $26.25. A few stores.
